headline: Coaching plans

faq.question: Do you coach beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. I coach riders of every level, from first group rides and centuries to Cat 1 racers. The plan starts where you are.

faq.question: Do I need a power meter?
faq.answer: No. A bike and a way to record your rides (a GPS computer or phone app) is enough to start. A power meter or heart-rate strap makes the training more precise, and I'll help you get the most out of whatever you have.

faq.question: Do I have to live in Austin?
faq.answer: No. Coaching happens through TrainingPeaks, email and video calls, so I work with riders anywhere. If you're local, we can also ride together and do bike fits in person.

faq.question: How soon will I see results?
faq.answer: Most riders feel a difference in 4–6 weeks of consistent training. Bigger gains come over a full 12–16 week block.

faq.question: Can I change plans or cancel?
faq.answer: Yes. Plans are month-to-month. You can move up, move down or stop at the start of any month.
